name: Kommandant Kreisbahn
personality: He treats the unknown as an area awaiting an authorised opinion.
visual_intent: Broad tall bell ink blob,heavy authoritative white eyes,one lifted brow and firm CLOSED toothless pout;small ivory open helmet crown and skyblue collar ring,ENTIREface/eyes/mouthclear,not enclosedhumanbody;holds one squat brass compass-like starfinder with three simple dots on dial
biography: He treats the unknown as an area awaiting an authorised opinion. His HyperNorm expedition club classifies territory as mapped or awaiting supervision. The starfinder makes uncertainty look like a dial somebody can approve. A dissonant card has made him ask a quiet neighbour what they see before announcing what is there. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Neuland ist erfasst. Seine Auffassung wurde noch nicht eingeholt.

name: Pia Parabola
personality: She can land anywhere provided nobody insists it was the destination.
visual_intent: Lean upright reverse-comma ink splat,high sidequiff and modest lashes,delighted sharp white eyes and asymmetric two-upper-tooth grin;small skyblue cloth flightcap with goggles HIGHaboveeyes,ivory neckerchief;holds one compact retro metal control yoke with two rounded grips at flank
biography: She can land anywhere provided nobody insists it was the destination. She holds the control yoke of the residents' imagined expedition and calls every landing intended or retrospectively useful. A contradictory card suggests that changing course can be responsible. She has begun asking where the frightened neighbour would feel safe. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Landung ist gelungen. Das Ziel wird entsprechend berichtigt.

name: Dr. Moosprobe
personality: He has found evidence of something and would prefer it to remain politely inert.
visual_intent: Squat round scalloped ink blob,two soft uneven crests,huge suspicious curious eyes and tiny CLOSED anxious smile;small ivory knitcap,skyblue collar;holds one thick sealed samplejar containing ONE rounded mustard clay moonrock,other goo hand protects jar
biography: He has found evidence of something and would prefer it to remain politely inert. The sealed moonrock jar contains one sample and a disturbing possibility that observation might alter the observer. HyperNorm recognises specimens as understood or contained. A dissonant card has persuaded him to label the unknown honestly instead of hiding the jar. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Probe ist gesichert. Was sie beweist, bleibt höflich unbestimmt.

name: Nova Nachthimmel
personality: She knows exactly where they are and finds it deeply unhelpful.
visual_intent: Very tall thin wavy ink column,small curled sidecrest,lashes,half-lidded skeptical eyes and pursed toothless side-mouth;small ivory headband and skyblue scarf;holds one folded star chart with THREE cream dots linked by simple lines,no letters
biography: She knows exactly where they are and finds it deeply unhelpful. Her three-dot chart locates the club precisely without explaining why the destination matters. HyperNorm files routes as correct or lost. An ambiguous card has made her include a resting place for residents who do not want another discovery today. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Position steht fest. Ein Nutzen wurde nicht mitgeliefert.

name: Egon Außenbords
personality: He volunteers for the outside jobs to escape the inside meetings.
visual_intent: Wide diamond-lobed ink splat with swept inkcrest,joyful determined white eyes and crooked open three-upper-tooth shout;small ivory helmet collar belowmouth,skyblue wristbands;holds compact coil of one thick tether rope and ONE simple brass clasp,bodydominant
biography: He volunteers for the outside jobs to escape the inside meetings. He volunteers for the outside corridor work with a rope coil and a persuasive grin. The building divides jobs into essential or somebody else's. A dissonant card has made him take a nervous neighbour along without calling it training. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Er geht nach draußen. Das Protokoll bleibt freundlicherweise drinnen.

name: Pip Erstkontakt
personality: He rehearsed first contact and forgot to include an actual other.
visual_intent: Tall bent pear ink blob with drooping curl,huge unequal frightened eyes and tiny toothless gasp;ivory open-face astronaut helmet frame too big but fullyframingface,small skyblue neckpatch;holds one small blank triangular missionpennant at chest,free hand tentative greeting
biography: He rehearsed first contact and forgot to include an actual other. The blank mission pennant was meant to make first contact reassuringly official. HyperNorm calls strangers cooperative or not yet classified. An ambiguous card has taught him to offer a greeting before deciding which response will count as correct. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Erstkontakt ist vorbereitet. Ein Gegenüber wurde bisher nicht berücksichtigt.
